help: The wheel menu: quick access to your equipment, consumables, hand gestures and mod settings.

content.help: Minimizes this menu and opens the wheel in front of you, to try your controls and pointer aim. Select by clicking; this menu comes back when the wheel closes.
Minimizes this menu and opens PALM's Wheel items and Wheel settings in RPS UI's settings menu, in front of you. This menu comes back when that one closes.

content.text: RobCo P.A.L.M., the Personal Access & Loadout Manager, is a wheel menu for Fallout 4 VR: up to eight items per category, hand gestures with ROCK and FRIK, and sections other mods add.

content.help: Opens PALM's page in your browser. Take off the headset to read it on your monitor.

content.text: <font color='#10FA78'>Opening the wheel:</font> click and release the right thumbstick, then point and click the pointing hand's trigger or A/X to select. Click Cancel to close. Other ways to open it are on the Controls page.
<font color='#10FA78'>Choosing items:</font> select Config on the wheel, then Wheel items. Wheel settings chooses which sections the ring shows.
<font color='#10FA78'>Adding what you hold:</font> hold a weapon, or a loose aid or food item, and select an empty slot on its page to add it to the wheel. Aid and food need ROCK.

content.help: How much PALM writes to RobCoPALM.log.

options.help: The basic log, for normal play.

content.help: Adds the Developer section to the wheel, which lists the actions mods add to it. A mod that adds its actions only at startup, as ROCK does, shows them after a restart.

pages.help: Which sections the ring shows. Changes show on the wheel as you make them.
How the wheel opens and how you select on it.

content.help: How the wheel opens and how you select on it.

options.help: Click and release the right thumbstick to open, then point and click the pointing hand's trigger or A/X to select. When ROCK's setup wizard moves PALM's binding, ROCK's Palm binding opens it.
Hold the right trigger and grip for half a second to open, then point and release to select. Release on Cancel to close.
Your own binding and way of selecting, set below. It is kept when you switch back to another mode.

content.help: Used while Input mode is Custom.
The button that opens the wheel, with an optional button held with it. Touch and stick pushes are not used.
How you select once the wheel is open.

options.help: Let go of the opening buttons, then click the pointing hand's trigger or A/X. The wheel stays open until you click Cancel.
Point while you hold the opening buttons, and let go to select. A tap or release binding always selects by click.

pages.help: Where each controller points on the wheel.

content.text: 0° points straight forward. A negative pitch lowers the pointer, and a positive yaw moves it right.

content.help: Tilts the left hand's pointer up or down.
Turns the left hand's pointer left or right.
Tilts the right hand's pointer up or down.
Turns the right hand's pointer left or right.
